app.name: DocuFlow
app.tagline: Your files. Your device. Your privacy.

imageTools.title: Image tools
imageTools.description: Compress to a target size, resize, and convert images to PDF.

pdfTools.title: PDF tools
pdfTools.description: Merge, split, organize pages and compress PDFs.

history.title: Recent jobs
history.clearNote: Clearing history removes these records only. Your documents are never deleted.

points.onDevice: Every image and PDF is processed on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
points.noAccount: There is no account and no cloud workspace.
points.noTelemetry: DocuFlow sends no telemetry or analytics and doesn't check for updates.
points.history: Recent jobs keeps file names and output locations on this device only. You can clear it at any time.
points.installer: On Windows, the installer may download Microsoft WebView2 if it isn't already installed.

errors.PdfEncrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Password-protected PDFs aren't supported yet.
errors.PdfMalformed: This PDF is damaged or isn't a valid PDF.
errors.TargetUnreachable: This image can't be made that small without dropping below the minimum quality. Try resizing it or choosing a different format.
errors.FileTooLarge: This file is too large to process.
errors.ImageTooLarge: This image has too many pixels to process safely.
errors.TooManyPages: This PDF has too many pages to process.
errors.PathNotAllowed: DocuFlow can only use files and folders you've selected. Please select it again.
errors.InvalidInput: Something about the input isn't valid.
errors.Io: The file couldn't be read or written.
errors.Internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
